issue.title: Improve the accessibility of focus outlines
issue.body_value:
Problem/Motivation

When Gin was moved over from contrib, it used box-shadow as a focus outline (Claro did so too for a while).

However, the vast majority of this has been rectified in default_admin as the CSS was refactored. However there several places where box-shadows may still be utilized as focus outlines. These need to be removed.

The focus outlines also utilize transparency, which can lead to potential issues. We need to refactor that out.

Related is #3619933: Drupal Admin Theme Colors

Steps to reproduce

Proposed resolution

  • Remove transparency from focus outline
  • Remove all box shadows from focus outline
    • There appears to be some left over in media library
    • Remove the variables too
    • Appears to be one box shadow focus state in dropbutton (line 636)
    • Also form checkbox
  • Ensure default focus outline meets 3:1 contrast over lightest surface color

comments.body_value:
IS needs updating for Default Admin.

Notes:

  • The values are defined in variables.pcss.css.
  • The current focus indicator is an outline and a box shadow.
  • Outline definition: --focus-outline (currently var(--outline-size) solid var(--admin-color-focus)).
  • Outline width: --outline-size (currently .25rem / 4px).
  • Box shadow definition: --focus-box-shadow (currently 0 0 0 var(--focus-border-offset-size) var(--admin-color-bg-surface), 0 0 0 calc(var(--focus-border-size) + var(--focus-border-offset-size)) var(--admin-color-focus);).
  • The outline does appear in forced-colors mode, but it's still hard to perceive because it's just a thicker version of the button border.
mgifford made their first commit to this issue’s fork.

merge_requests.title: better focus Drupal 3618140
merge_requests.author: mgifford
merge_requests.description:
This AI generated patch:
  • Adds a 2px gap between focus outlines and component borders.
  • Applies that offset to radios, checkboxes, media-library proxy indicators, and settings labels.
  • Replaces translucent focus colours with light/dark values meeting 3:1 against applicable theme surfaces.
  • Preserves the 4px real outline for Forced Colors.
  • Fixes custom focus colours using the obsolete --gin-color-focus token.
  • Updates generated CSS.
